finding.title: The code does not check if array_size or segment_size are zero or negative, which could lead to buffer overflow when allocating memory or performing operations.
The code does not handle errors from cudaMalloc and cudaMemcpy, which could lead to memory leaks if these functions fail.
The code does not check if cudaFree calls succeed, which could lead to use-after-free errors if the memory is still in use.
The calculation of blocksPerGrid could overflow if array_size is very large.
